title: grammitis myriophylla
intro: Grammitis myriophylla, commonly known as the Polynesian shield fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is native to tropical regions and is valued for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Grammitis myriophylla include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve immune function, due in part to its therapeutic actions of anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects.
